description.zh: 把生产配置挡在 agent 工具之外：按分组登记目录与文件，点名/解析到/写入的调用在执行前被拒绝；父目录仍可列目录、glob、grep，受保护条目自动从结果里剔除。策略级防护，不是操作系统隔离。
description.en: Keeps production configuration out of agent tool calls: register directories and files per group; calls that name, resolve to, or write one are denied before they run, while parent directories stay searchable with protected entries removed. Policy-level protection, not OS isolation.
